scenarios.name: Escalating Middle East Conflict
scenarios.description: Military conflict in the Middle East intensifies, disrupting oil supplies and increasing energy prices.

impacts.explanation: Higher energy costs from oil supply disruption directly increase CPI components.
Fed raises rates to counter inflationary pressure from energy shocks.

scenarios.reasoning: Based on historical precedents like 2022 Russia-Ukraine war (outside view), current tensions in Gaza and Iran-Israel dynamics suggest moderate probability of escalation.
tetlockCommandments: Look for the clashing causal forces at work

scenarios.name: China-US Trade Thaw
scenarios.description: US and China reach partial trade agreement reducing tariffs and stabilizing tech restrictions.

impacts.explanation: Reduced tariffs boost US exports and lower import costs.
Improved supply chains enhance manufacturing output.

scenarios.reasoning: Recent diplomatic signals and economic interdependence suggest cautious optimism. Historical trade cycles (base rate) show periodic recoveries after multi-year dips.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between under- and overreacting to evidence

scenarios.name: US Recession Triggered by Rate Tightening
scenarios.description: Federal Reserve's aggressive rate hikes lead to credit tightening, reduced investment, and economic contraction.

impacts.explanation: Tighter credit slows business investment and consumer spending.
Economic slowdown leads to layoffs across sectors sensitive to interest rates.

scenarios.reasoning: Using inside view (current Fed rhetoric and yield curve inversion) combined with outside view (historical recessions post-rate hikes), probability reflects moderate economic tightening.
tetlockCommandments: Bring out the best in others

scenarios.name: Cyber Attack on US Financial Infrastructure
scenarios.description: Major cyberattack disrupts banking systems or critical financial market infrastructure.

impacts.explanation: Payment processing failures and economic uncertainty reduce consumer spending.
Supply chain disruptions due to logistics system compromise.

scenarios.reasoning: Low base rate historically, but increasing frequency of state-sponsored cyber threats raises tail risk. Cybersecurity experts rate this as plausible but unlikely.
tetlockCommandments: Look for errors behind your errors

scenarios.name: Climate Disaster Impact (Hurricane Season)
scenarios.description: Severe hurricane season causes significant infrastructure damage and economic disruption in key US regions.

impacts.explanation: Regional economic activity halts during disaster recovery period.
Reconstruction delays and supply chain issues for construction materials.

scenarios.reasoning: Seasonal pattern analysis (outside view) plus current warming trends suggest above-average storm activity. Historical average hurricane costs provide base rate calibration.

scenarios.name: Federal Reserve Cuts Rates Due to Weakness
scenarios.description: Weakening economic data prompts Fed to pivot from tightening to rate cuts, boosting asset markets.

impacts.explanation: Rate cut expectations drive long yields lower.
Lower mortgage rates stimulate housing demand.

scenarios.reasoning: Current Fed dot plot shows mixed signals. Inside view suggests data dependency. Outside view from past cycles shows cuts typically follow clear economic deterioration.
tetlockCommandments: Update forecasts as new info arrives

methodology: Applied Tetlock's superforecasting methodology emphasizing probabilistic reasoning, base rate analysis, scenario decomposition, and continuous updating based on geopolitical and economic developments.
geopoliticalSummary: US-China tensions persist but show signs of thaw in trade negotiations. Middle East conflicts remain volatile, with potential for energy price shocks. Russia-Ukraine war continues affecting global energy markets.
geoeconomicSummary: Global supply chains are recovering but remain fragile. Currency fluctuations affect trade competitiveness. Decoupling trends in technology and green energy investments reshape economic alliances.
currentEventsSummary: Key events include Fed rate decisions amid inflation concerns, escalating climate disasters affecting regional economies, ongoing cyber threats targeting infrastructure, and shifting US foreign policy priorities in multipolar world.
